messages:
marta: We need a network-level routing policy that is region-aware and also falls back to model variants when capacity is constrained. Thinking latency-first for paid tiers, cost-first for free tier.
alex: Agreed. We should make the decision tree explicit in config so routing is debuggable and the console can show the chosen path.
raj: +1. Can we also add a telemetry label for the reason a fallback happened? e.g., "fallback_reason=region_capacity" or "fallback_reason=variant_unavailable".
kevin: Yup, that helps trace regressions. Also want to avoid churn: prefer sticky region affinity for sessions when within latency SLO.
yun: For free-tier customers do we allow >1s tail? we should cap fallback to cheaper variants but signal quality drop to customer.
alex: Prototype policy (rough):
```
{
  "policy": "latency_then_cost",
  "customer_tiers": {
    "enterprise": {"latency_threshold_ms": 180, "prefer_local": true},
    "standard":   {"latency_threshold_ms": 300, "prefer_local": true},
    "free":       {"latency_threshold_ms": 600, "prefer_cost": true}
  },
  "regions": ["us-west1","us-east1","europe-west1"],
  "fallback_order": ["same_region_variant","other_region_variant","cheaper_variant","cpu_fallback"],
  "metrics": ["p50_latency_ms","p95_latency_ms","fallback_rate_by_tier","model_variant_used"]
}
```
marta: That looks good. Need to map "cheaper_variant" to a concrete variant list per model so we don't pick incompatible quantizations.
raj: Could be a per-model matrix in model-catalog: e.g. model_x -> [fp16, 8bit, 4bit, cpu]. Router uses that list.
kevin: UX ask: console rollout page should include a live column showing "routing decisions" breakdown during canary: %requests->preferred_region, %requests->fallback_variant, avg latency.
deploy-bot: buildkite:queued: job=router-canary branch=region-fallback-proto
yun: For telemetry: include tags {region_probe_latency_ms, region_capacity_util, variant_inflight_tokens} so we can build the decision model offline.
alex: Also want a small backoff knob per region so we don't thrash between regions when latency fluctuates. Something like: if region latency increases by >30% for 10s then demote weight for 60s.
marta: Agree. And document the routing graph in API spec: consumers can pass optional `region_hint` and `require_local=true` for strict routing (enterprise only).
raj: Action items:
- alex: PR for routing proto + console wireframe (due EOD Thu)
- raj: telemetry labels + dashboard skeleton (p95/p99 + fallback rate) (due Mon)
- kevin: UX mock for rollout breakdown and per-request trace (due Fri)
- marta: update model-catalog fallback matrix and write migration plan (due next Wed)
kevin: Quick Q: how do we expose fallback_reason to end users? internal header? SDK field?
alex: Expose in SDK response metadata as `routing_info:{region, variant, fallback_reason}`. Default off for free tier to avoid leaking infra details.
marta: Cool. If no objections I'll start the PR & sched a 30m sync tomorrow. :thumbsup:
kevin: +1
raj: +1
yun: Thanks everyone.
